items.title: 1 dead, 8 injured in shooting after college football game in Alabama
items.brief: At least one person was killed and eight others injured in a shooting after a college football game in Birmingham, Alabama, on Saturday night, officials said.

items.title: Sen. Chris Murphy hospitalized with stroke and expected to make full recovery, his team says
items.brief: Democratic Sen. Chris Murphy has been hospitalized after experiencing a stroke and is expected to make a full recovery, his team announced Sunday.

items.title: The last-minute surprises and sideshows of the 2026 campaign
items.brief: The 2026 midterm elections mostly revolve around deeply serious business.

items.title: Russia’s security service detains a teenager planning a ‘terror attack’ after a US tip-off
items.brief: A suspect allegedly planning a terror attack on a major Moscow museum was arrested by Russian authorities after a tip-off from the United States, Russia’s security agency FSB announced on Sunday.

items.title: A record number of health professionals are running for office. Could they help heal US politics?
items.brief: At least 125 doctors, nurses and public health experts are on the ballot for Tuesday’s midterm elections — an unprecedented number from fields that historically offered fewer paths to elected office than boardrooms…

items.title: 4 killed, about 15 injured after multiple overnight shootings in Dallas neighborhood, police say
items.brief: Four people were killed and approximately 15 others were injured after multiple overnight shootings in one of Dallas’ vibrant nightlife neighborhoods, police said.

items.title: Binance withdrawals resume following $6 billion hack
items.brief: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, said it has resumed withdrawals after a record $6.3 billion was stolen from its digital wallets last week .

items.title: Democratic leaders enter the midterms ‘confident and paranoid’
items.brief: No part of a rolling, decadelong existential crisis is ever easy, even when things seem on the cusp of going well — and especially when Democrats have had their hopes raised and dashed so many times.
